youtube.title: Henry VIII got catfished by a painting… then she won the divorce 🖼️ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Henry VIII fell for a portrait of Anne of Cleves. Then he met her. 🖼️😐

He called it a catfish. She called her lawyer and walked away with castles.

Who really won this one? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1540: Henry married Anne of Cleves after Holbein's portrait, said she looked nothing like it, and annulled the marriage after 6 months. Anne got Richmond Palace, Hever Castle, an income and the title "the King's beloved sister".
